lightingIsotropy.method: Magnitude-weighted 36-bin signed luminance-gradient orientation histogram using central differences at gradient magnitude 12 or greater, excluding classified water and immediate water neighbours.
lightingIsotropy.interpretation: This is a texture and edge-direction proxy, not calibrated illumination ground truth. The low signed first moment does not cancel the visible cap-versus-face value split.
lightingIsotropy.visualGate: failed: pale rock caps and upper rims remain brighter than darker column faces, so the required equal cap and face value is not demonstrated.

terrainFractionMethod: Manual source-image area estimate: broad level grass shelves and the hollow floor are buildable; column faces and steep talus are steep; rough, wooded, or uncertain land is other. Approximate uncertainty is plus or minus 0.08 per fraction.

water.method: Source-resolution manual trace of the complete coastal surf and wash boundary plus every visible stream, spring, fall, splash, and ripple run; binary polygons and rounded channel traces were inspected over the raw source.

crown.method: Full-frame hue/value component census expanded to visible foliage envelopes, then source-image review removed fern and grass false positives; every identified conifer including saplings and clipped edge crowns remains in the median.

crownEvidence.limitations: Dense overlapping stands are not segmentation ground truth; connected visible envelopes can merge close crowns. No element was removed because of size.

eastWaterHandover.gate: failed: the nearest classified east-edge stream run is wide enough but its center is about 170 final pixels from the required center, outside the 48-pixel tolerance.

site.name: fern-hollow
site.observation: A sheltered mossy spring hollow with dense ferns and a continuous outlet beck is visible on the middle bench.
site.scaleGate: failed: the visible sheltered envelope is roughly 23 to 25 metres across and the mossy spring floor is roughly 15 metres across, not the requested 30-metre hollow.

reviewFindings.finding: The required eastern water handover is not centered at the registered lower-edge position; the measured nearest classified crossing is outside tolerance.
Rock caps and upper rims remain visibly lighter than column faces, contradicting the binding equal-value flat-lighting requirement.
Fern-Hollow is visibly smaller than 30 metres across even when measured to its sheltering walls.
The first ten metres inside much of the eastern seam remain olive and stony rather than a continuous cooler blue-green moor strip.
Several central scarps still read as fairly regular upright column palisades rather than consistently weathered irregular walls.

positiveObservations: The source is one square whole-canvas edit with no remaining grey block or interior texture ring.
The southern coast includes open sea, a shingle cove, surf, low cliffs, and two distinct interior becks that continue through visible falls to the sea.
Terrain reaches the north, east, and west edges and no structures, roads, paths, rails, figures, or markers are present.
The measured conifer crown median is inside the required 1.7-to-5.2-metre band.
